purpose: Describe an action continuing throughout another period.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Plain nonpast verb / ている + 間; noun + の間.
While my mother was cooking, I washed dishes.
I stayed at my grandmother’s throughout summer vacation.
I was reading while waiting for the train.
formation: Plain nonpast verb / ている + 間; noun + の間.
restrictions: The main state or action lasts across the relevant interval.
mistake: Use 間に when locating a bounded event somewhere within the interval.
